description:
Purpose: First alpha build to validate our GitHub Releases flow and end-to-end packaging/signing. Core app path is working, but this is not production-ready.

**What’s in this build**

Electron desktop shell with local services (FastAPI) wired to NT Core (test accounts)

Basic sign-in and project flow (happy path)

Initial telemetry/logging for internal diagnostics

Core app functionality for asset analysis and AI Editing.

**Notes**

Alpha channel only; for internal testing and setup verification

Expect rough edges; functionality is subject to change before beta/stable
